source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source_name: Rhynchosia senna Gillies ex Hook. var. texana (Torr. & A. Gray) M.C. Johnst.
source_reported_historical_synonyms: Rhynchosia senna var. angustifolia (A. Gray) Grear

morphology_source_reported.habit: Minutely pubescent, stems to 70 cm long
morphology_source_reported.leaflets: 4–18 mm wide, ovate-lanceolate or elliptic to narrowly oblong
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Yellow, often reddish or brownish tinged
morphology_source_reported.diagnostics: 1–3 flowers in leaf axils, in contrast to elongate flower racemes of R. minima [key]

cautions: 1999 Flora treats only var. texana; morphology cannot automatically be assigned to every R. senna variety
Historical taxon concept requires reconciliation before identification-scoring use
Regional habitat does not establish local BONAP nativity
